findings.claim: 10-K 指出收購 Global Payment Network 後，COF 與其他支付網路競爭 Network Partners，並與 Visa、Mastercard 的競爭可能影響既有合作；另面臨穩定幣、代幣化存款等新興替代支付業者。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: As a result of our recent acquisition of the Global Payment Network, we now face substantial and increasingly intense competition in the payments industry, both from traditional players and new, emerging alternative payment providers.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出部分競爭者（含數位與行動支付、金融科技業者）不受同等監管，且部分對手規模遠大於 COF，可能在資金成本與通路上占優。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Some of our competitors are substantially larger than we are, which may give those competitors advantages, including a more diversified product and customer base, the ability to reach more customers and potential customers, operational efficiencies, broad-based local distribution capabilities, lower-cost funding and larger existing branch networks.

findings.claim: 2026 Q2 信用卡購買量約 2,538 億美元，年增 26%（含 Discover 併入效應）；舊 Discover 購買量年增不到 2%，舊 Capital One 業務約 14%；搜尋結果未見美國網路份額的 2026 數據。
findings.source: eMarketer：Capital One's Q2 earnings size up the new titan of the credit card industry

findings.claim: COF 已完成簽帳卡轉到 Discover 網路，並測試信用卡轉移。
findings.source: PYMNTS：Capital One Tests Moving Credit Cards to Discover Network
findings.excerpt: Capital One Tests Moving Credit Cards to Discover Network By PYMNTS | July 21, 2026 | Listen to Article Listen Highlights Capital One card purchase volume reached $253.8 billion, while legacy Discover purchase volume increased just under 2%.
